sources.entry: AI Engineer Pack: A curated bundle of offers from various AI companies, which has previously included extended free trials for services like ElevenLabs and Perplexity Pro.

summary.name: AI Engineer Pack
summary.one_liner: A curated bundle of offers and discounts from many AI and developer-tool companies, presented by ElevenLabs.
use_cases: discover developer tools for building AI apps
get access to discounted or trial AI services
find LLM APIs and evaluation platforms
compare AI infrastructure and monitoring vendors
summary.what_it_does: The page is a landing page listing many AI and developer-tool companies whose offers are bundled together, including ElevenLabs, Mistral AI, Perplexity, E2B, Fin, Chatbase, Clerk, CodeRabbit, Daytona, Exa, Firecrawl, Hugging Face, Neon, Sentry, Braintrust and others. Each entry is a one-line description of that vendor's product, such as text-to-speech, LLM APIs, code review, web scraping, browser automation for agents, or incident response. The page itself does not describe specific bundle contents or how to claim them beyond the listing's note that past offers included extended free trials. Overall it functions as a directory of vendor offerings for AI developers.
notable: Bundles offers from many AI and developer-tool vendors in one place
Previously included extended free trials for ElevenLabs and Perplexity Pro (per listing)
Includes a wide range of categories: LLM APIs, agent infrastructure, evals, observability, and dev tooling
caveats: Specific offer terms, eligibility and current pricing are not stated on the page
Listing notes past offers; current availability is not confirmed
